title: Whiskey Distilleries Have Discovered A Surprising Way To Make Money Without Selling More Whiskey
summary: From Kentucky's Bourbon Trail to Scotland's single malt distilleries, tourism is becoming an increasingly important business as traditional whiskey sales slow.
